mods.name: AutoBridge
mods.description: Client-side build-forward helper: auto-places a block ahead of you while you walk, so you don't have to hold right-click to bridge across gaps. No packet spoofing, no fake rotations, no anti-cheat evasion — it just automates the click using your real aim, exactly like holding the mouse button would.

releases.notes:
Fabric 1.21.1 client mod. Toggle with **B**: automates the right-click block placement using your real crosshair target and real held item — no rotation faking, no packet spoofing, no anti-cheat bypass.

Only auto-places while you're actually looking down (>=35° below horizon), same as real bridging by hand — keeps the block at your feet instead of popping up in your face while you walk.

**Install:** Fabric Loader + Fabric API for 1.21.1, drop `autobridge-1.0.0.jar` into `mods/`.
